text:
maya: Starting regional rollout: v3.2.0 -> v3.2.1 (runtime tweaks). Plan: US 10% canary -> EU 5% -> APAC 5%. Start now. Pin config version=2026-03-20. Anyone seeing preflight concerns?
liam: On it. Kicking off preflight checks now.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: release v3.2.1 scheduled. canary slices: us-west-1 (10%), eu-central-1 (5%), apac-southeast-1 (5%). Initiating us-west-1 slice at 2026-03-20T13:00:21Z.
noah: us metrics baseline: qps ~ 4.2k, p95 latency 210ms, gpu util 62%.
priya: Observability dashboards look green. Setting rollback thresholds: error rate +3% absolute OR p95 > 400ms OR infra OOMs.
yun: Noted. I'll watch KV cache miss rate — new kernel might change cache pressure.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: us-west-1 canary rollout at 10% complete. 200/200 slices started. No failures.
liam: Running smoke: basic completions, streaming, tool-calls. sample prompts ok.
noah: Spot check: one worker node reporting mem spike 78% -> 92% after warmup. PID: 4521. Not OOM yet. GPU mem stable.
priya: :thinking_face: Increase drain window? We have autoscale warm pool of 3 nodes in us-west-1. Recommend 2m slow-start.
maya: Agree. Throttling ramp: change window +2m. Pin rollback window to immediate if OOM or error delta >3%.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: adjusted canary ramp for us-west-1 to 2m slow-start. Next slice launch in 90s.
sre-oncall: If mem climbs past 95% for >30s, trigger rollback and scale-up. I'll prepare quick rollback job.
liam: Putting EU canary on hold until US stable. Not moving EU traffic yet.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: us-west-1 canary stable at 10% for 6m. metrics: error rate +0.1%, p95 230ms.
noah: GPU util after warmup 68%. KV cache miss +1.2%. Looks fine.
yun: APAC infra note: we have smaller warm pool; request permission to start APAC at 2% instead of 5% to avoid prewarm churn.
maya: Approved. Start APAC at 2% and hold. EU still on hold.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: apac-southeast-1 canary started at 2%.
noah: APAC smoke: p95 280ms, qps 320. Mem stable.
priya: Runbook check: adding manual holdpoint before EU scale. @maya set manual gate.
maya: Manual gate set. EU will not progress until I ack.
liam: Quick note — release notes pushed to internal changelog: runtime kernel patch, kv cache tuning, fix for streaming fd leak. Link: https://internal/docs/releases/3.2.1
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: us-west-1 canary completed. promoting to US full rollout in waves: 25% -> 50% -> 100% each 10m, with monitoring gates.
noah: Recommend waiting one full wave and check regen traffic spike first.
maya: Ok we wait 1 wave. EU gate still manual.
priya: If EU lags due to mem, plan: pin EU to previous model variant (v3.2.0-quant), and route EU traffic there until we patch.
liam: How to pin: example command: `infractl pin --region eu-central-1 --model v3.2.0-quant --until 2026-03-23`
yun: I've prepared rollback snippet: `infractl rollback --thread ${thread_ts} --scope eu-central-1` saved in ops-snippets.
maya: Good. One more check: SLA-sensitive customers in EU — notify account-ops if we pin. @noah can you draft a 1-line note?
noah: Draft: 'Heads-up: EU canary paused for capacity tuning; customers on dedicated plans unaffected. ETA for resolution: 2–4 hours.'
maya: Send after we decide. For now, we hold EU and watch US/APAC.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: US wave1 (25%) in progress. Traffic sliced & throttled. Observability hooks active.
noah: Wave1 p95 245ms, error +0.2%. Proceeding to 50% in 8m if stable.
priya: :thumbsup: 
maya: If anything crosses rollback thresholds we revert US to v3.2.0 and pin EU/APAC to v3.2.0-quant and notify. Keep me posted.
liam: I'll keep a live thread in the release dashboard. ping me if you want me to cut the rollback.
sre-oncall: Monitoring runbook attached: `If mem >95% for 30s -> run infractl scale-up eu 2`
maya: Thanks team. I'll be on standby. Will ack EU gate once US completes wave2.
